name: Air Fryer Babybel Cheese Wheels
desc: Babybel Light rounds double coated in egg and seasoned breadcrumbs, frozen, and air fried into crisp mini cheese wheels.

source.title: Air Fryer Babybel Cheese Wheels
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 6 Babybel Light cheese rounds, wrapper and wax removed

steps: Set up the whisked eggs and the breadcrumbs in two shallow bowls.
Dip each cheese round in egg, then press into the breadcrumbs to coat. Repeat the egg and crumbs for a second coat so the shell holds.
Freeze the breaded rounds on a plate for 30 min.
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F. Spray the rounds on both sides with oil and set them in the basket without touching.
Air fry 4 to 6 min, turning halfway, until golden brown and crisp. Eat warm.
tips: A lower-calorie swap for mozzarella sticks. Freezing the breaded rounds for 30 min first helps them hold their shape.
Pull them as soon as they are golden; a minute too long and the cheese breaks through the crust.

references.title: Air Fried Babybel Cheese
